one_line: Late Great Kushan ruler who faced rising Sasanian power while championing Shiva and Nandi on his coinage.

appearance.age_look: late 40s, broad-shouldered, dignified and athletic rather than bulky
appearance.face: oval face with strong jaw, medium wheat-brown complexion, straight prominent nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, thick brows, calm intense eyes with a steady gaze, default expression composed and resolute with a hint of stern focus
appearance.hair: rich black hair gathered into a high, smooth topknot wrapped in a narrow deep-red cloth band, the topknot rising slightly above a gold diadem-style crown with a central oval gem and small Kushan-style flame-like points
appearance.costume: He wears a long Kushan-style quilted tunic of warm cream cloth reaching just above the knees, its front and cuffs edged with narrow maroon borders and simple repeating geometric motifs in dull gold; over this is a sleeveless, slightly flared overcoat in deep maroon wool, open at the front, with a subtle diamond-quilt texture and a broad golden-brown sash tied firmly at the waist; his trousers are straight, slightly loose riding-style pants in soft matte brown, tucked into sturdy mid-calf leather boots in dark brown with simple stitched bands; around his neck sits a thick gold torque and a short strand of medium-sized gold beads, and his wrists carry two plain gold bangles each; a light, off-white woolen shawl is draped from his left shoulder across his back, with a faint border band in muted red and brown, evoking travel between Mathura and Gandhara without obscuring his arms or torso
appearance.signature: A historically grounded long straight sword with a simple iron blade and a slightly rounded tip, carried sheathed at his left hip; the scabbard is dark brown leather with two narrow gold bands near the throat, and the hilt has a straight iron crossguard, wooden grip wrapped in dark red cord, and a small rounded metal pommel.

ref_desc: Vasudeva I is a late-40s Kushan ruler with a wheat-brown oval face, short beard, black topknot bound in red beneath a gold diadem, cream quilted tunic, maroon overcoat, brown trousers, gold ornaments, and a dark brown-sheathed straight sword accented in gold and deep red.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Vasudeva I: a late-40s Kushan ruler with an oval wheat-brown face, strong nose, thick brows, short neatly trimmed beard and moustache, and calm intense eyes. His black hair is pulled into a high smooth topknot wrapped with a narrow deep-red cloth band, rising just above a gold diadem-like crown with a central oval gem and small flame-shaped points. He wears a long cream-coloured quilted tunic reaching just above his knees, edged on the front opening and cuffs with maroon borders and simple dull-gold geometric motifs, and over it a sleeveless deep maroon wool overcoat, open at the front, with subtle diamond quilting and a broad golden-brown sash tied at the waist. His straight, slightly loose brown riding trousers are tucked into sturdy mid-calf dark brown leather boots with simple stitched bands. Around his neck show a thick gold torque and a short strand of gold beads, with two plain gold bangles on each wrist. A light off-white wool shawl with muted red and brown border bands is draped from his left shoulder across his back without hiding his main garments. At his left hip, clearly depict his signature straight sword in a dark brown leather scabbard with two narrow gold bands, the hilt having a straight iron crossguard, wooden grip wrapped in dark red cord, and a small rounded metal pommel. Use cream, maroon, gold, brown, and deep red as the dominant colours, and present him in a neutral, dignified stance suitable for consistent redrawing from head to toe.
